items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: he was conducting for McKinney, too, because McKinney was a drummer but he didn't play in the band.

ctx.x: So I said -- in fact, he was conducting for McKinney, too, because McKinney was a drummer but he didn't play in the band.

So anyway they wouldn't pay me my salary. I just told -- I took the clarinet, Billy Borne's clarinet. Then that started a fight. There was a free-for-all on the bandstand and everybody jumped on me but Prince and Roy Eldridge. And I was just BEATING guys all over the bandstand. So we fought all the way down to the hotel.
